titre: Production de la construction en zone euro
sous_titre: Variation sur un an, en %, de décembre 2025 à juillet 2026

series.nom: Production de la construction, zone euro

Décembre 2025.texte: In December 2025, compared with December 2024, production in construction decreased by 0.9% in the euro area

Mars 2026.texte: In March 2026, compared with March 2025, production in construction decreased by 1.2% in the euro area

Avril 2026.texte: In April 2026, compared with April 2025, production in construction increased by 0.9% in the euro area

Juillet 2026.texte: In July 2026, compared with July 2025, production in construction decreased by 2.0% in the euro area
